tasks.title: Add Picture/Image (Vision) Support to grok-cli
tasks.description: Implement image input support via both /image command and direct prompts. Support local files + URLs. Auto-switch to vision model. Images are ephemeral (no session persistence).
tasks.details:
Requirements:
- Support /image <path|url> [prompt]
- Detect image references directly in prompts
- Auto-switch to vision-capable model
- Local files + URLs supported
- No image storage in sessions
- Use existing base64 dependency
tasks.testStrategy: Manual testing with local images and URLs + vision model responses

subtasks.title: Extend API request builder (proper multimodal content array passthrough)
Add TUI feedback for attached images

tasks.title: Persist workflow traces as JSON files for replay
tasks.description: Save completed WorkflowTrace objects to disk as JSON (e.g. ~/.grok/workflows/<timestamp-or-session>.json). Support loading and replaying traces.
tasks.details:
Add serialization (serde) for WorkflowStep + WorkflowTrace.
Store files under a dedicated workflows/ directory.
Add helpers:
- save_trace(trace)
- load_trace(path)
- list_traces()

Keep traces ephemeral by default or configurable.
tasks.testStrategy: Write a trace, reload it, assert the steps and data are identical. Test replay of a failed + fixed workflow.

tasks.title: Add /trace slash command to show last workflow
tasks.description: Implement the `/trace` command (and variants like `/trace last`, `/trace <id>`, `/trace list`) that displays the most recent (or selected) workflow trace using the new TUI viewer or pretty-printed output.
tasks.details:
Extend the slash command parser.

Commands:
- /trace          → show last trace in TUI
- /trace list     → list saved traces
- /trace <id>     → load and show specific trace
- /trace json     → dump raw JSON

Hook into the new WorkflowTrace storage.
tasks.testStrategy: Test all variants in a running grok-cli session. Verify it correctly shows traces from both current session and persisted files.

tasks.title: Task-graph version that parallelizes clippy + check
tasks.description: Re-implement (or extend) the workflow runner using a proper task-graph/DAG so that independent validation steps (cargo check + cargo clippy) can execute in parallel, with proper dependency tracking.
tasks.details:
Leverage the existing `execute_task_graph` tool or build a small internal DAG executor.

Example:
- Node A: LLM generate code
- Node B: cargo check (parallel with C)
- Node C: cargo clippy
- Node D: cargo test (depends on B + C)
- Decision node after all

Keep the WorkflowTrace recording working across parallel execution.
tasks.testStrategy: Create a workflow that runs check + clippy concurrently. Measure wall time vs sequential. Verify trace still records all steps correctly and decision logic works.

tasks.title: MCP 2026-07-28 Phase 1: Full stateless mode (post-spec release)
tasks.description: Once the 2026-07-28 spec is officially released, switch the default behavior to the new stateless model.
tasks.details: Phase 1 COMPLETE. Protocol version defaulted to "2026-07-28". Stateless mode (_meta injection on every request) is now the default (use_legacy_handshake=false). Added full ToolListMeta support (ttlMs, cacheScope) + list_tools_with_meta(). Legacy handshake preserved for old servers. Updated mcp_test_echo, client, protocol, config, integration points (mcp_tools, acp). No remaining tasks/list or major capability breakage. All core changes verified via code inspection and cargo check.
tasks.testStrategy: New default connections use stateless model. Existing servers that still require handshake can opt-in via config. Full tool discovery and calls work without initialize.

subtasks.title: Switch default to 2026-07-28 + remove mandatory handshake
Implement ttlMs / cacheScope support on list results
Audit and fix breaking protocol changes
subtasks.description: tasks/list removal, Roots/Sampling/Logging deprecation, error code updates, etc.

subtasks.title: Update mcp_call, list_tools, and ACP integration paths

tasks.title: MCP 2026-07-28 Phase 2: HTTP transport + routable headers (future)
tasks.description: Implement proper HTTP/Streamable transport for MCP so grok-cli can take advantage of the new stateless + routable design (Mcp-Method, Mcp-Name headers, W3C trace context, no session affinity).
tasks.details:
This is lower priority because current usage is stdio + ACP.

Includes:

- Proper stateless request handling (no Mcp-Session-Id).
- Edge caching / ttl support integration.
tasks.testStrategy: Can connect to an HTTP MCP server using the new 2026 stateless model. Headers are correctly set and round-tripped.

subtasks.title: Add HTTP transport support to McpClient

tasks.title: ARCH-1: Split monolithic config/mod.rs into focused sub-modules
tasks.description: src/config/mod.rs is approximately 3100 lines with 25+ structs. It is too large to safely reason about. Split into focused sub-modules one area of concern at a time.
tasks.details: Progress: Most targeted sub-modules have already been extracted (network, security_cfg, ui, acp, tools, logging, bayesian, okf, context, general, model, experimental, accessors). Current mod.rs is ~876 lines (down from ~3100). Remaining work: clean up ThinkingMode, possibly extract paths/dirs + ConfigSource logic, ensure clean re-exports, and finalize tests/docs. Do incremental improvements.
tasks.testStrategy: cargo test must pass after each extraction. cargo build must have zero warnings. All existing call sites like config.network.starlink_optimizations must still compile without changes.

tasks.title: COR-4: Promote strip_jsonc and list_code_definitions regexes to Lazy statics
tasks.description: strip_jsonc_trailing_commas and list_code_definitions compile their Regex on every call. These are hot paths called on every file read and definition scan.
tasks.details: In src/tools/file_tools.rs, declare static RE_JSONC_TRAILING_COMMA and RE_CODE_DEF at module level using once_cell::sync::Lazy, matching the pattern already used in web_tools.rs for RE_SEARCH_RESULT and RE_STRIP_TAGS. Use .expect("BUG: invalid static regex") for the unwrap. Replace the in-function Regex::new calls with references to these statics. Check for any other in-function regex compilations and promote them.
tasks.testStrategy: cargo test passes. cargo clippy with -D warnings produces no warnings about regex construction in a loop. Optional: benchmark read_file on a large JSON file and confirm improvement.
